prompt: node tls server ticketKeys buffer internal composition
answer:
Node’s `server.getTicketKeys()` returns a 48-byte buffer composed of three 16-byte values:

| Offset | Size | Contents |
|---|---:|---|
| 0–15 | 16 bytes | Prefix |
| 16–31 | 16 bytes | HMAC key |
| 32–47 | 16 bytes | AES key |

Node internally uses three 16-byte keys but exposes them as one 48-byte buffer. (Search results: [Node TLS documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/tls.html), [Node documentation mirror](https://node.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/tls))
